scope: Prepare a one-use in-memory native exclusive-reaping readiness probe, not a census or release

covered: Correct bound real source refuses Windows

intendedProbe.onlyNativeOperations: Read self task/signal context through the frozen backend; no query transport, child launch, signal send or service control
intendedProbe.reports: Correlation nonce, source digest, owner PID, filtered readiness/error metadata

limitations: Local Windows negative execution is not Linux readiness, kernel ABI validation or target-host proof.
The pinned backend's constructors are trusted source dependencies; their internals were not re-reviewed in this readiness-only review.
A passed JSON status must be paired with genuine exit code zero and the client's expected nonce/source binding.
The nonce is a correlation tag, not replay authorization; the inactive manifest is informational, not an execution permission mechanism.
The SSH runner and external hard-deadline envelope must be integrated and tested before any separately scoped live attempt.
Actual producer introspection, worker execution, whole-cgroup clearance, capacity and production delivery remain separate gates.
Only this sanitized record is committed; private package sources, raw logs and packet contents remain local.
proposedNextScope: Local integration of the existing fingerprint-pinned SSH transport and external deadline; after targeted tests, at most one read-only VPS readiness attempt, remote20s/local35s, no new Linux unit or service/file changes.
